label: The Author
tagline: A page that breathes around a single paragraph
cluster_explainer: Practitioners read the engine for what it does to attention over time, with zero tolerance for popups or nudges.
demo_highlights: Torus reads as a cycle — a sentence that returns, like a chapter that revises itself
Mid-band reactance tracks the vocal and harmonic body where the emotional center of a paragraph lives
Neon preset warms the frame like late-afternoon reading light without ever becoming illustration
Smooth envelope (0.7) keeps transitions between moods quiet — the same paragraph in two moods reads as two objects, not two clips
One photograph in, one tone out: the demo is a still image made to breathe, not a video editor
